spread_policy: The launcher uses an empty AlphaFactory CLI value for current spread; the sealed receipt and run manifest bind the normalized semantic value current. No spread is converted into performance because the EA submits no orders.
commission_policy: Not applicable in HYP006 because orders and deals are forbidden.
slippage_policy: Not applicable in HYP006 because orders and deals are forbidden.
future_economic_child_requirement: A fresh economic child must freeze observed spread, broker commission and dynamic slippage stress before opening returns.
